item.title: Pentagon leaders award 2 Purple Hearts to Old Dominion cadets who took down ISIS supporter
item.summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll honored ODU ROTC cadets with Meritorious Service Medals and Purple Hearts for stopping an ISIS-linked attack on campus.

item.title: Van Hollen avoids saying if he trusts Iran over Trump, calls president a 'liar'
item.summary: Maryland Democratic Sen. Chris Van Hollen avoided saying whether he believed Iranian officials over President Donald Trump on potential war discussions.

item.title: Charles Barkley delivers stern message to parents who don't 'whoop' their kids: 'Believe in discipline'
item.summary: Charles Barkley said during a March Madness interview that modern athletes are uncoachable and argued that strict parenting, including discipline, is necessary for kids today.

item.title: Gavin Newsom regrets calling Israel 'apartheid state,' but sounds alarm on 'legitimate' concern in region
item.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom said he regretted describing Israel an apartheid state, clarifying he referenced a Tom Friedman article about Bibi Netanyahu's direction.

item.title: Olympians condemn IOC for statement on Iran's execution of 19-year-old wrestler Saleh Mohammadi
item.summary: Seven Olympians, including gold medalists, condemn the IOC for failing to denounce the reported execution of Iranian wrestler Saleh Mohammadi, calling the response a moral failure.

item.title: Democrat strategist warns Mamdani's ballooning NYC budget plan gives Republicans a ready-made midterm message
item.summary: Democratic strategist Melissa DeRosa says NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's $127B budget hands Republicans a perfect midterm attack on tax-and-spend Democrats.

item.title: Greater weight loss promised by higher-dose Wegovy shot, now approved by FDA
item.summary: The FDA approved Wegovy HD, a higher-dose semaglutide for weight loss in adults with obesity, offering greater weight reduction, as experts warn of side effects.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: GOP eyes DHS deal funding ICE probes, but not removals, as shutdown drags
item.summary: Senate Republicans reportedly plan to end the partial DHS shutdown by funding most of the agency while leaving ICE enforcement and removal unfunded.

item.title: Minnesota millionaire who qualified for food stamps warns of 'fraud by design' loophole ahead of hearing
item.summary: A millionaire says he qualified for food stamps via a SNAP loophole and will testify at a Minnesota state hearing pushing for stricter asset test reforms.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW avoid covering Loyola student Sheridan Gorman murdered by illegal immigrant in Chicago
item.summary: The murder of 18-year-old Loyola University Chicago student Sheridan Gorman by an illegal immigrant received no coverage on CNN and MS NOW, according to transcripts.
